item.text: I’ll inspect the MIME handling and browser utilities, update the checked-out files, then run the relevant existing tests.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' | head -80 && git status --short && rg -n \"mimeTypeFromFile|SupportedMimeTypes|EXTRA_EXTENSION_TYPES|isSupportedImage|class Version|isHEICSupported|isJXLSupported\" . --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"'"

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Task: Add Safari 17+ HEIC/JXL thumbnail and preview support; simplify MIME detection.
Status: Inspecting repository and existing tests.
Constraints: Local code/tests only; preserve git history, index baseline, and harness configuration.
EOF
find . -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -100
git status --short
grep -R -n -E 'mimeTypeFromFile|SupportedMimeTypes|EXTRA_EXTENSION_TYPES|isSupportedImage|class Version|isHEICSupported|isJXLSupported' --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git . | head -150"

item.text: The parser currently skips extension lookup for empty files, and the extension helper already has a default MIME type. I’ll remove the file reader gate, use a specific file type when present, and let extension lookup handle empty or generic types. I’ll gate HEIC and JXL on Safari 17+ on Mac OS or iOS.

item.text:
Added Safari 17+ HEIC/HEIF and JXL support for thumbnails and previews on macOS and iOS. [MIME detection](/app/packages/drive-store/store/_uploads/mimeTypeParser/mimeTypeParser.ts) now uses a specific file type first, then the extension, without reading file content. The [JXL MIME type and extension mapping](/app/packages/shared/lib/drive/constants.ts) and [browser checks](/app/packages/shared/lib/helpers/mimetype.ts) are in place.

The six relevant existing tests pass; formatting and diff checks pass. Package type checks remain blocked by errors outside the changed files, including a crypto type mismatch and missing Drive exports and config modules.
